g.title: L: Length = 6 in. The block's length, along its slot.
W: Width = 4 in. The block's width, across its slot.
E: End = 1-1/4 in. From each end of the block to its slot.
SY: Slot side = (W - SW) / 2. From the block's side to its slot.
SL: Slot length = L - 2 * E. The slot's length.
SW: Slot width = 1-1/4 in. The slot's width.
HX: Hole in = E / 2. From the block's end to a hole's center.
HY: Hole side = W / 2. From the block's side to the holes' centers.
HS: Hole spacing = L - E. Between the holes' centers.
